subject: design/installer-without-browser-review
statement: New releases use release-manifest/v2 and omit the dependency-bundle hash. Current readers support both v2 and legacy v1; v1 still requires a valid bundle hash. Verification checks any pinned legacy bundle and refuses unpinned extra artifacts. Packaging refuses stale dependency archives in the output directory. Old v1-only readers reject v2 explicitly; users upgrade through `pyxis upgrade` or the bootstrap installer before repinning. The exact wire object is carried in the paired solution shape.
